pi-foundry.purpose: Pi environment desired-state, exact resolution, installation, evaluation, promotion, update, repair and rollback.

software-factory.purpose: Inspectable software-development workflows, work units, gates, isolated workspaces, acceptance, operational evidence and draft-PR integration.

pi-protocol.purpose: Capability contracts, discovery, principals, grants, invocation, sessions, receipts and causal provenance.

pi-dev.purpose: Profile-backed software-development role providers such as scout, architect, worker and reviewers.

pi-pe.purpose: Optional deterministic data-only fixed capability pipelines.

rules: Never implement a source fix in a copied reference directory.
Use public package or Pi Protocol contracts across repository boundaries.
Create and link one issue in the authoritative repository when a dependency change is required.
Mutable refs resolve to exact commits or artifacts before proposal, execution, or evaluation.
Dirty local source requires explicit policy and remains observed-unverified until tested.
